summary: Tested 3 new features on top of TeeBox: Direct Messaging, Group Chat, and Season History. Backend: 24/24 new pytest cases pass (100%) covering DM start/resume (self-msg 400, unknown user 404, idempotent pair_key resume), DM send/list/unread-count/pagination/mark-read, notification correctness (recipient gets 'direct_message' notif, sender does NOT), group chat member-only 403 for non-members, sender enrichment, confirmed SILENT (no notification emitted for group chat messages), group seasons endpoint (member-only 403, includes current year, sorted desc), and regression on leaderboard?season= param (current + past year). Frontend (Playwright, 390x844, logged in as reese@teebox.demo and jordan@teebox.demo): feed header 'header-messages' chat icon present and navigates to /messages; conversation list renders correctly with live previews; DM chat send works with optimistic right-aligned bubble, persists after re-fetch, back button returns to list correctly (verified via page.url after prior screenshot-ordering confusion was resolved); user/[id].tsx 'Message' button resumes the same conversation ID as an existing thread; group detail 'Group chat' CTA navigates to /groups/[id]/chat, member can send/receive with instant echo; Leaderboard tab shows 'Season · 2026' header correctly (no year chips since group created this year, matches expected behavior per manual smoke test note); Notification settings has 'Direct messages' toggle; notifications.tsx renders 'sent you a message' items with chat icon and correctly navigates to the exact DM thread on tap.

minor.issue: Sending an empty string '' (not whitespace) returns 422 (Pydantic min_length=1 validation) instead of the app-level 400 used for whitespace-only text. Cosmetic inconsistency only — both are 4xx client errors, not a functional bug, but worth aligning if strict API consistency matters.

issues: Could not detect a distinct unread-badge testID on the header-messages chat icon (searched for header-messages-badge / *messages-badge*, found 0). Badge may only render conditionally when unread_conversations > 0 at the exact poll tick — not confirmed broken, but couldn't visually verify the badge count during testing since by the time screenshots were taken conversations were already read via ChatThread's auto markRead on load. Recommend a quick manual check with a fresh unread DM.

action_items: (Nit) Align empty-string validation to return 400 consistently instead of 422 for message text endpoints, or accept 422 as-is since it's still a valid 4xx client error.

(Low priority, unverified) Double check the unread badge on the feed header's chat-bubble icon actually renders/updates live — was not able to visually confirm during this pass since existing conversations were already marked read by the time of screenshot.
critical_code_review_comments: messages.py: pair_key (sorted user-id pair) correctly guarantees a single conversation regardless of who initiates — verified both directions resolve to the same conversation id.
Sender's own read-state auto-advances on send (avoids self-unread bug) — correctly implemented and verified via test_sender_does_not_see_own_message_as_unread.
Group chat correctly shares messages_col/chat_reads_col with DMs via thread_type discriminator — clean reuse, no duplication.
Group chat notification path (send_group_chat_message) intentionally omits emit_notification call — confirmed silent-by-design behavior via test showing 0 notifications after group message.
group_seasons endpoint is O(1) (derives from created_at, not a rounds scan) — good perf choice noted in code comments.
All new endpoints properly exclude _id, validate membership via _require_member/_get_conversation_or_404, and return proper 403/404 codes.

ChatThread.tsx: optimistic message with tempId correctly reconciled/removed on success/failure; polling interval (4s) cleaned up on unmount; inverted FlatList + onEndReached for pagination is a sound pattern for chat UIs.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (feed header nav, conversation list, DM send/persist/back, profile Message button + thread resume, group chat CTA + send/receive, leaderboard season header, notification settings toggle, direct_message notification tap-to-navigate)

seed_data_creation: None beyond TEST_-prefixed groups/messages created and cleaned up (groups) inside pytest fixtures. DM messages sent during testing (TEST_ prefixed) remain in the demo conversations between reese/jordan/sam as harmless seed-like chat history — not cleaned up since DMs have no delete endpoint in scope, consistent with feature design (chat history is expected to persist).
context_for_next_testing_agent: DM, Group Chat, and Season History are all stable and working end-to-end, backend and frontend. Only open item is a low-priority unread-badge visual verification on the feed header icon that couldn't be confirmed live (not a confirmed bug, just untested edge case). Season year-chip UI (multi-season selection) is untestable right now since no existing group spans more than one calendar year — would need a group with created_at backdated to a prior year to fully exercise the chip-selection reload behavior.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no functional bugs found. Only a cosmetic 422-vs-400 validation status code inconsistency for empty (not whitespace) message text, and an unverified (not confirmed broken) unread badge visual on the feed header.
